newsitem.title: USA: Florida investigates Loewen Group bid.
newsitem.headline: Florida investigates Loewen Group bid.

text.p: Florida officials confirmed on Friday they were investigating the anti-trust implications of Service Corp International's proposed takeover of The Loewen Group Inc.
"We're concerned about all kinds of mergers that essentially put market concentration in the hands of a very few," said Florida Deputy Attorney General Peter Antonacci.

He said Loewen and Service between them control about one-fourth of the funeral and cemetery market in Florida statewide, with a much higher concentration in the highly populated southern portion of the state.
He said the investigation was in its preliminary stages, with the state obtaining documents and planning to speak with witnesses as it assesses the situation.
"We could certainly block a takeover within our own jurisdiction... within the geographic boundaries of Florida," Antonacci said.
He said he was not aware of any other states that had begun investigations, but said he believed Loewen had approached other states about potential antitrust implications of a merger.
Vancouver-based Loewen this week rejected a $2.8 billion bid by Service, which was widely expected to launch a higher bid next week.
